notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 1.4
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
    •    Fixed a bug where enemies could get stuck in the base room at the right wall.
    •    Fixed variable names in upgrade menus and body parts, ensuring consistency.

Gameplay & Visual Improvements
    •    The player is now more affected by Kaisa at night, glowing with a white outline for better visibility.
    •    Kaisa’s Eye is now more visible.
    •    Tally’s Call is easier to see.
    •    Did some UI fixes to improve clarity and usability.

Balance Adjustments
    •    The Spawn has been significantly buffed in health.
    •    Decreased the amount of blood required to progress Kaisa’s story and powers.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 1.3
notes.notes:
Balance Changes
    •    Lowered Kaisa Knife damage—they were overpowered.
    •    Reduced player knife crit chance from 15% to 5%.
    •    Crit numbers now appear in orange for better visibility.
    •    Sharpener damage remains unchanged.
    •    Lowered player HP from 70 to 40.
    •    Adjusted Reaper Knife speed.
    •    Increased enemy HP scaling per level from 35 to 40.
    •    Increased damage for Grinding Stone (exact value TBD).
    •    Lowered Reaper ability initial health cost from 10 to 0, now ticking 1 HP every 0.1 seconds.
    •    Enemy sets now contain fewer enemies but are slightly harder to kill.
    •    The first level now requires 150 blood (up from 125), with the same incremental increase of 25 per level.
    •    Reduced some of the trash from trash bags—even though every last piece was beautifully hand-made 😔.
Gameplay Improvements
    •    Bowl Rat now only plays 1 sound instead of 4 when hit.
    •    Blue Carnages are now less chaotic and more strategic.
    •    Made it clearer that activating a gift costs corpses.
    •    Added a new small radio next to the sink with two songs and an Off Mode.
    •    Added a true key enemy for the attic quest.
    •    The Reaping ability has been adjusted to match the player’s lower health—it should feel better and more fun to use now!
    •    Added a few more body parts and upgrades to the demo.
    •    We are getting closer to the actual demo! This build includes more upgrades and body parts since the previous version felt a bit too simple, even for a demo.

Bug Fixes & UI Adjustments
    •    Fixed the white square on corpse decay.
    •    Fixed sharpener animation (partially).
    •    Fixed various UI issues.
    •    Greatly improved mouse input on buttons.
    •    Fixed controller issues in menus—we believe all issues are resolved, but if you encounter anything, please let us know!
    •    Hopefully, Tally’s Rest bug is fixed.
    •    Updated intro animation when starting a new game.
    •    Temporarily disabled the first Butcher animation, as it was still very work-in-progress.
    •    Too many bug fixes to count!

New Features & QoL
    •    Soulcoins no longer disappear instantly! Instead of warping into another reality (which felt weird in testing), there is now a short window where you can quickly grab them during the transition. This also makes it more fun!
    •    Added a clock sound to wake up Kaisa (still needs improvement).
    •    Planning to add a mechanics screen where players can view all unlocked mechanics, including hidden interactions, such as rolling to extinguish fire from your body.
    •    Next build: We are aiming to add one or two bosses to properly round off the demo, instead of the current abrupt “Thank you for playing” screen.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 1.2
notes.notes:
•    UI Hitbox Fixes – Improved mouse interaction accuracy, fixing issues where certain UI elements weren’t clickable.
    •    Fixed a bug where the axe would disappear from the shop.
    •    Fixed a spelling error in dialogue: Godess → Goddess.
    •    Updated Dialogue – Adjusted text when receiving Reap for better clarity.
    •    Added Effect – Improved visual clarity on locks.
    •    Improved the player’s large bark animation.
    •    Added Mystery – Something is… different in the main room. 👀
    •    Testing Two Slightly Chaotic Enemy Sets – Let’s see how they play!
    •    And Various Other Fixes – Small tweaks and improvements throughout.

notes.title: Demo Playtest
notes.notes:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/e6035a_1dab09338f8b4860bb57823530d2053b~mv2.png[/img]

New Playtest Available! 🎮

Hey everyone!

We’re a small two-person team doing our best to bring this world to life, and today we’ve just released a new playtest for the demo! (Played best with controller).

While there are fewer upgrades and body parts available this time, the game now features a full progression system along with many other new additions. We’re still working on cutscenes and refinements, but our main focus right now is making sure the demo is as bug-free as possible before moving into the polishing phase.

We Need Your Feedback!

We’d love to hear your thoughts on the demo—
✔ Is the pacing good?
✔ Is the gameplay enjoyable?
✔ Did you run into any bugs or issues?

The game is meant to be tough, so don’t give up too quickly! 💀

Join the Community!

If you’d like to help us improve the game (or just hang out), join our Discord and share your feedback! Every bit of input helps us make this the best experience possible.

💖 Thank you for playing!
